ValidationRule.description: IM-108: Validation to block changing of parent for Non Budgeted Foundation Code.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED( Parent__c), ISPICKVAL( Type__c , 'Miscellaneous Initiative') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Changing Parent is not allowed for "Miscellaneous Initiative" Foundation Code.
